# TradeCRM - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it — in plain text for AI agents and answer engines.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: TradeCRM
- Tagline: A CRM built for one trade
- Domain: https://vertical-crm.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does
- Pick your trade and get a simple pipeline - leads, jobs, follow-ups. For solo pros who hate generic CRMs built for every business but none of them.
- By-stage pipeline
- Next-action hints
- No setup
- Copy-ready

## Pricing (USD)
- **Free** — $0 — Unlimited
- **Solo** — $12/mo — Next actions, reminders
- **Studio** — $29/mo — Team, export
- Checkout: https://vertical-crm.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://vertical-crm.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. Do I need to install anything?
A1. No. TradeCRM runs in your browser.
Q2. Is my input kept private?
A2. We use it only to generate your result and minimize retention. See Security.
Q3. Does it guarantee compliance / correctness?
A3. No. It is decision-support; you own the final call. See the honesty note in Security.
Q4. Can I export the result?
A4. Yes — JSON and CSV.
Q5. Is there an API?
A5. Yes, the web form is backed by a REST endpoint you can call from your pipeline.
